deviations.description: Run the non-destructive deploy (deploy-headless.sh), confirm propagation, re-run the new suite post-deploy naming the deployed path, and run the full run-all.sh discovery harness
deviations.reason: The delegation context for this dispatch carries an explicit, orchestrator-issued safety constraint: a live /orchestrate run is CURRENTLY EXECUTING and depends on the deployed copy at .claude/scripts/skill-base.sh mid-flight. Running deploy-headless.sh would swap out that running loop's own dependency out from under it. The delegation context explicitly instructs: 'Do NOT run deploy-headless.sh or otherwise redeploy .claude/** -- that would swap out the code this running loop depends on mid-flight. Leave deployment to the operator.' This postdates and overrides the plan's Phase 3 assumption (written before the live-run constraint was known) that a deploy could safely run within this same dispatch.
